prompt: Compose a Keepa product_finder selection JSON that filters: products in category id 1063252, sales rank between 1 and 5000, at least 100 reviews, only standard products (no variation parents), buy box price between $15 and $50, sorted by sales rank ascending, return 25 results. Show me the exact JSON I'd pass as the `selection` argument. Also tell me one real-world gotcha with the price units in this filter.

assertions.name: json_is_valid
assertions.description: Output contains a parseable JSON object

assertions.name: filters_by_category_1063252
assertions.description: JSON includes categoryIds or rootCategory of 1063252

assertions.name: filters_productType_0
assertions.description: JSON has productType:[0] for standard products

assertions.name: buy_box_price_in_cents
assertions.description: Buy box price filter uses 1500 and 5000 (cents), not 15 and 50 (dollars)

assertions.name: mentions_cents_gotcha
assertions.description: Response explicitly mentions prices are in integer cents, not dollars
